# Relief palette

`palette.js` is copied unchanged from github.com/AdmcCarthy/Relief (`preview/palette.js`, commit b8b1025, MIT, Adam McCarthy).
Used for the Detuned style of the location map: land tints at half strength by climate zone, the sea floor on a wide indigo ramp.
The hex values in this file are Relief's; our own files take colour from SubScout tokens.
